name: AWS IAM Access Path Analyzer
purpose: Map IAM role trust relationships, assume-role reachability, privilege escalation paths, and cross-account access risks.

parameters.name: source_arn
parameters.description: source IAM principal ARN to trace from — empty to analyze all

parameters.name: target_resource
parameters.description: target resource ARN to check reachability to — empty for full graph

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: AWS profile name from Cloud Profile context
